description: Changes a design create_design made, before the user saves it: set fields of a layer by id, add, remove or reorder layers, or replace a variant's background, loop or title, or add or remove a variant. Send only what changes. Returns new preview images and warnings, like create_design; the open_url create_design gave then opens the new version. A design changed with edit_asset keeps changing there, and one the user already saved changes in the editor (or with edit_asset by asset_id once they sign you in).

changes.description: Applied in order. Positions count from 0 at the bottom.

gradient.description: A gradient instead of a plain colour; radial runs from the centre out.

angle.description: linear: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom. Default 90.

colors.description: 2 to 5 colours, evenly spread across the whole canvas.

id.description: The layer, for set_layer, remove_layer and move_layer.

layer.description: A layer with create_design's fields. set_layer: only the fields to change (motion {"move":"none"} stops it). add_layer: the whole new layer.

background.description: flow sways a gradient, shift drifts the colours a little round the wheel. Default still.

color.description: Leave it out for a colour that shows on the background.

effect.description: Particles over the whole canvas. Anyone can try them; exporting them needs appdesigns Pro.

layer.description: front draws over everything, back just over the background. Default front.

seconds.description: Loop length: 5 to 30 for the header and search result (default 8), 15 to 30 for event art (default 15).

new_variant.description: add_variant: a whole variant, as in create_design.

op.description: set_layer changes the fields you give of layer id; add_layer adds layer (on top, or at position to); remove_layer and move_layer (to a position, 0 is the bottom) take id; set_background, set_loop and set_title replace those of the variant; add_variant adds new_variant; remove_variant removes the variant.

to.description: move_layer and add_layer: the position, 0 is the bottom.

variant.description: Which variant, from 1. Every op but add_variant needs it.

name: update_design
title: Change a listing art design
